description: Drive an auto run: chain the plan-loop → handoff → work-loop using the self-pacing pulse (lib/pulse.py), the agent-managed dispatcher (lib/dispatcher.py), and a deliberate-stop /goal binding. Use when invoked via /auto, when continuing after a handoff, or when resuming a run. This skill IS the driving agent: arms the pulse chain, decides the work-loop fan-out cap per wave (resizable in flight), reads the run-record's cached exit predicate to know when the loop is done. NEVER re-evaluates the predicate itself.
